newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-KLAMMER AND COMPANY RACE FOR A CAR.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-KLAMMER AND COMPANY RACE FOR A CAR.

text.p: Franz Klammer, Ingemar Stenmark and other former skiing greats will compete in their own race at the world championships.
No gold medals will be at stake but the winner of Friday's Legend Race on a giant slalom course will receive a new car.
Organisers said competitors would race under handicaps based on their ages and retirement dates.

Entrants include Austrians Klammer, Leonhard Stock, Harti Weirather, Karl Schranz and Toni Sailer, Italy's Gustavo Thoeni and Piero Gros, Canadian Ken Read and Swiss Bernhard Russi, Franz Heinzer and Pirmin Zurbriggen.
The women racers include American Cindy Nelson, Liechtenstein's Hanni Wenzel, France's Marielle Goitschel and Switzerland's Vreni Schneider.
Between them, the veterans boast 66 titles in various disciplines, 20 Olympic gold medals and 410 World Cup wins.
